headline: Approved four one-day liquor licenses, a temporary Guinness Pub extension, and a lodging license renewal; accepted withdrawal of Mehfil application at 50 Rogers St.
summary: The board approved four one-day liquor license requests and a temporary extension of alcohol service for a Guinness Pub. It also renewed a lodging license for Action Inc. and accepted the withdrawal of a Rogers St. license petition. The board continued a change of manager request for The Salted Cod Arthouse and agreed to hold applications for an available annual all-alcohol on-premise license until a timeline is set.
decisions: Accepted the withdrawal of the Gloucester Restaurant Group, dba Mehfil, petition for a new Annual Section 12 All Alcoholic Beverages License at 50 Rogers St., 3-0.
Approved the special one-day liquor license petition of Peter Williamson for the Annual Music Festival at Lanesville Community Center, Inc., 8 Vulcan St., 3-0.
Approved the special one-day liquor license petition of Catherine Gunn for the Arts and Crafts Show Preview Gala Party at Annisquam Village Hall, 32 Leonard St., 3-0.
Approved the special one-day liquor license petition of Kimberly Trainor for a fundraising cycling event at Stage Fort Park, 24 Hough Ave., 3-0.
Approved the special one-day liquor license petition of Isabel Pett for Schoonerfest at Maritime Gloucester, 23 Harbor Lp., 3-0.
Approved the extension of David Linquata's alcohol service area for a temporary Guiness Pub on September 23, 2026, 3-0.
Approved the Lodging License Renewal for Action Inc., Emergency Shelter, 370 Main St., 3-0.
Continued the petition of The Salted Cod Arthouse LLC, dba The Salted Cod Arthouse, 53 Rocky Neck, for a change of manager to Matthew Moynahan to the next meeting.
Approved a motion to hold any applications received for the available all-annual on-premise license until a timeline and criteria are established, 3-0.

plain_text:
CITY OF GLOUCESTER 
                                               LICENSING BOARD MEETING 
 
HARBOR MASTERS OFFICE 
19 HARBOR LOOP #2 
GLOUCESTER MA 01930 
 
Meeting Minutes  
August 11, 2026 
 
 
Board Members Present: 
 
Melissa J. Teixeira Prince, Chairperson  
John Lamirande  
Ted Costa 
 
 
Also in Attendance: 
Natasha Dale, Licensing Board Clerk  
Rob Vicari, Building Commissioner  
 
The Chair Calls to Order the Quorum of the Licensing Board at 6:35 PM. 
 
The Chair reads the following statement; 
 Effective August 16, 2023 the public is welcome to attend our meetings in person. 
Alternatively, the public may attend through the zoom link listed on the agenda. The 
meeting notice will reflect if this a meeting of zoom only. As the recent amendments to 
the Open Meeting Law allows the Committee can continue to hold the meeting remotely. 
Please note that the in person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if 
technological problems interrupt the remote connection.  
 
Continued Business: 
Petition of Gloucester Restaurant Group, dba Mehfil on a proposed new Annual, Section 
12 All Alcoholic Beverages License at 50 Rogers St. Manager of Record: Prabjhot 
Pabla 
 
Jackson Christian, 56 Central Ave., Lynn is present on zoom. 
 
Mr. Christian states that his clients are asking to withdraw the application for a new 
license at 50 Rogers St. 
 
Ms. Prince moves to accept the withdrawal of the petition of Gloucester Restaurant 
Group, dba Mehfil on a proposed new Annual, Section 12 All Alcoholic Beverages 
License at 50 Rogers St. Manager of Record: Prabjhot Pabla
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Special One Day Liquor License Applications: 
 
Petition of Peter Williamson requesting to serve wine and malt beverages only during 
the Annual Music Festival on 9/19/2026 with a rain date of 9/20/2026 from 12:00 PM- 
6:00 PM at Lanesville Community Center, Inc., 8 Vulcan St., Gloucester.  
 
Peter Williamson, 1 Sargent St. Unit 3, Gloucester 
 
There are no changes from previous years.  
 
Orange fencing will be placed around the property and another fence around the 
property. The alcohol will be locked up until we start selling. Numerous board members 
will be monitoring the building. 
 
Mr. Williamson does not feel the need for a police detail, but if need be Ms. Prince states 
to contact the police department. 
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the petition of Peter Williamson requesting to serve wine 
and malt beverages only during the Annual Music Festival on 9/19/2026 with a rain 
date of 9/20/2026 from 12:00 PM- 6:00 PM at Lanesville Community Center, Inc., 8 
Vulcan St., Gloucester. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Petition of Catherine Gunn requesting to serve wine and malt beverages only during the 
Arts and Crafts Show Preview Gala Party on 10/10/2026 from 5:00 PM- 9:30 PM at 
Annisquam Village Hall, 32 Leonard St.  
 
Catherine Gunn, 44 Pleasant St., Gloucester is present on zoom.  
 
Ms. Gunn is requesting to serve wine and beer at the annual arts and craft show. This is 
a ticketed event. All alcohol will be stored in a locked cabinet and have hired TIPS 
certified bartenders who have done the event in the past.  
 
The liquor is being delivered by Main Street Liquors in Everett. There have been no 
complaints from the public in the past.  
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the petition of Catherine Gunn requesting to serve wine and 
malt beverages only during the Arts and Crafts Show Preview Gala Party on 10/10/2026 
from 5:00 PM- 9:30 PM at Annisquam Village Hall, 32 Leonard St. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0
Petition of Kimberly Trainor requesting to serve malt beverages only during a 
fundraising cycling event on 9/19/2026 from 6:00 AM- 4:00 PM at Stage Fort Park, 
24 Hough Ave.  
 
Kimberly Trainor, 3 Litchfield Wy, Burlington is present on zoom.  
 
This is an annual event that has no rain date. It will be held rain or shine.  
 
There will be a big tent and everything will be in just the one tent. The barricades will be 
sponsor banners. There is one entrance and one exit and there will be security checking 
ids. Everyone over 21 will have a wristband. Guests under 21 will be allowed in the tent 
this year.  
 
All servers are TIPS certified and the beer is coming from Boston Beer. There are no 
road shut downs.  
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the petition of Kimberly Trainor requesting to serve malt 
beverages only during a fundraising cycling event on 9/19/2026 from 6:00 AM- 4:00 
PM at Stage Fort Park, 24 Hough Ave. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Petition of Isabel Pett requesting to serve malt beverages only during Schoonerfest on 
9/5/2026 from 9:00 AM- 6:00 PM at Maritime Gloucester, 23 Harbor Lp.  
 
Isabel Pett, 12 Beach Rd., Gloucester is present on zoom.  
 
Ms. Pett is requesting a one day liquor license for Heritage Day during Schoonerfest. 
 
Rockport Brewing is hosting the event and will be bringing their beer truck to distribute 
the beer.  
 
Security will be in place checking ids and bracelets will be worn for over 21. Signs will 
also be posted saying “no alcohol past this point”.  
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the petition of Isabel Pett requesting to serve malt 
beverages only during Schoonerfest on 9/5/2026 from 9:00 AM- 6:00 PM at Maritime 
Gloucester, 23 Harbor Lp 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Extension of Premise:
David Linquata of Seven Seas Wharf., dba Gloucester House Restaurant is requesting to 
extend his alcohol service area to serve food and alcohol at a temporary Guiness Pub 
from 11:30 AM- 12:00 AM. 
 
David Linquata, 4 Reef Knot Wy., Gloucester is present.  
 
The truck will be to the left of the entrance in the first 30 feet. The boundaries are large 
lobster traps across the entrance.  
 
Guiness will be placing the trailer right at the entrance. Mr. Vicari has no zoning issues 
with the trailer. 
 
Wristbands will be used for everyone 21 and older. There will be 2 bouncers at the door. 
 
Mr. Linquata purchased all of the beer for the trailer to distribute.  
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the application of David Linquata of Seven Seas Wharf., dba 
Gloucester House Restaurant is requesting to extend his alcohol service area to serve 
food and alcohol at a temporary Guiness Pub from 11:30 AM- 12:00 AM on September 
23, 2026. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Lodging License: 
 
Action Inc., Emergency Shelter, 370 Main St. 
 
Mr. Vicari states that they have passed all of their safety inspections. 
 
Mr. Costa moves to approve the Lodging License Renewal for Action Inc., Emergency 
Shelter, 370 Main St. 
 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
New Business: 
 
Petition of The Salted Cod Arthouse LLC, dba The Salted Cod Arthouse 53 
Rocky Neck on a change of Manager to Matthew Moynahan. 
 
This matter was continued to our next meeting.  
 
Discussion by the Board: 
 
The Licensing Board will discuss the availability of 1 (one) Annual All-Alcohol On-
Premise License.  The Board will also discuss and establish a timeline for the application
process, including the opening and closing dates for the acceptance of applications, the 
review process, and any related procedural deadlines.   
 
Ms. Prince that’s that there is an available license up for grabs.  
 
At the next meeting, the board will be setting a deadline of accepting applications, 
discuss the criteria, set the advertising date and set a date for the public hearings.  
 
Ms. Prince moves that the Licensing Board, effective immediately will hold any 
applications received for the available all- annual on-premise license until a timeline 
and criteria is established.  
Mr. Costa seconds 
All in favor, 3-0 
 
Adjournment:  
 
Mr. Costa moves to adjourn at: 7:05 PM 
Mr. Lamirande seconds 
All in favor, 3-0
